name: Hotel Sportklause
beschreibung: Hotel Sportklause is located in the scenic Leukental valley in Kirchdorf in Tirol, framed by the Kitzbühel Alps. The property is designed in authentic alpine style, welcoming outdoor enthusiasts and families alike. In winter, guests enjoy direct access to ski areas in Kirchdorf and nearby St. Johann in Tirol, alongside extensive summer hiking and biking trails. Facilities include a relaxing wellness area with sauna and steam bath, sports storage, and regional dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Sportklause in Kirchdorf in Tirol offers cozy alpine lodging, a sauna and steam bath, regional half-board dining, and quick access to Kitzbühel Alps ski slopes.
